_doc: Learned QC lessons. 'global' constraints are injected into EVERY panel prompt (prevention). 'by_tag' constraints are applied when repairing a panel with that issue tag. When a rework proves a fix, record it here so quality is maintained, not re-discovered. Update via: node 02b-verify.mjs --learn-global "..." or --learn tag="...".
global: Draw every character as a COMPLETE full-body figure from head to feet, standing in the scene; never a cropped, disembodied, or floating head.

by_tag.cropped_figure: Show each character's FULL body head-to-toe; absolutely no floating or disembodied heads.
by_tag.extra_figures: Include ONLY the exact characters listed and no others; no duplicate or extra figures.
by_tag.identity_drift: Keep each character's fixed signature (glasses / top hat / bald-hollow-eyed ghoul) identical to every other panel.
by_tag.scene_mismatch: Depict the stated action clearly and literally.
by_tag.capzone_blocked: Keep the caption zone as empty plain background.
by_tag.style_drift: Keep a clean thin black-and-white cartoon line style.
